issues: White field, mid-grey type and a pale grey pill — the first half has almost no color or light, like a wireframe of the source
The finished page is a title plus three lines, with no context explaining what tags do
The pill is flat, so the first hard cut lacks weight
Both halves are light, so the second hard cut relies only on a palette swap
changes: Paper look, with the first half using its ink as a warm dark stage (top light, grain), 180px Futura typing and a steady vermilion caret as the only color; the second hard cut flips the page to paper white, amplifying the snap

Materialize stays a 1-frame hard cut: a thick cream pill with lit rim, volume gradient and warm two-layer shadow, lifted 16px, while the stage key light steps up in the same frame; only a 3f 1.03→1 settle

The finished page is a full notes app 'Tern': tag sidebar (#music highlighted, count 12), breadcrumb, 132px title, pill + ghost 'Add tag', 46px body and a linked-notes row
